analysis_set.span: The primary outcome was recurrent pericarditis in the intention-to-treat population.

notes: Searched all three packet source texts: the cached abstract, Europe PMC abstract, and registry eligibility and outcomes. Despite the brief, the packet contains no held_local/...html full text. The abstracts do not state follow-up for the served recurrence estimate. The registry specifies a protocol recurrence outcome at 18 months but does not link it to the served estimate or establish the longest reported follow-up; the 6-month duration is treatment duration. Adults with multiple recurrences are within the question, which explicitly includes that disease stage; no entry criterion establishes a population outside the question.
